data.one_liner: Renders HTML table tags within the flutter_html package using flutter_layout_grid.
data.what_it_does: This extension package allows the <table> tag to be rendered using the flutter_html package. It calculates the best fit for each element and sizes its cells accordingly, supporting Rowspans and colspans.
use_when: You are already using flutter_html and need to render <table> tags.
You need table cells to span across multiple rows and columns.
avoid_when: You are not using the flutter_html package.
You need a standalone table widget independent of HTML rendering.
strengths: Supports rowspans and colspans for complex table layouts.
Calculates optimal aspect ratios and cell sizes automatically.
weaknesses: Not documented for standalone use outside of flutter_html.
data.setup_notes: Register TableHtmlExtension inside the Html widget extensions parameter.
